title: Chilaquiles with {p}
steps: Cut the {s} into wedges and crisp them in a hot pan with a little oil, or bake until crunchy.
Sauté the {v} with the {spice}, then add the {sauce} and simmer 3 minutes.
Stir the {s} into the sauce just to coat, and fry or poach the eggs until the whites are fully set (160°F / 71°C for firm yolks).
Top with the eggs and serve right away, so the chips stay a little crisp.
tip: Bake the tortilla wedges instead of frying them, and top with extra veg and avocado.
